bugs.error_message: Error: Cannot find package '@testing-library/dom' imported from node_modules/@testing-library/jest-dom/dist/matchers-*.mjs (all 8 vitest suites failed to load)
bugs.root_cause: Installing eslint-plugin-react with --legacy-peer-deps (its peer range caps at eslint ^9.7, project has eslint 10) made npm re-resolve the tree without auto-installed peer deps, silently dropping @testing-library/dom, a peer of @testing-library/jest-dom.
bugs.fix: Dropped eslint-plugin-react entirely (ESLint 10's core no-unused-vars is already JSX-aware, verified with a probe file), then ran a plain `npm install` to restore the tree. 106/106 tests pass.

bugs.error_message: [@stylistic/eslint-plugin-js] This package is deprecated in favor of the unified @stylistic/eslint-plugin, please consider migrating to the main package
bugs.root_cause: The js-only stylistic plugin (v4) was archived upstream in favour of the unified @stylistic/eslint-plugin. Migrating renames the namespace @stylistic/js/* -> @stylistic/*, and the unified v5 changed one default: indent SwitchCase 0 -> 1, which then flagged 48 pre-existing switch statements in src/lib/errors.js and src/utils/periods.js.
bugs.fix: npm uninstall @stylistic/eslint-plugin-js; npm i -D @stylistic/eslint-plugin (5.10.0). Renamed the plugin key to @stylistic and all four rule prefixes. Pinned { SwitchCase: 0 } on @stylistic/indent so the enforced style is byte-identical to before - zero source files reformatted. lint clean, 106/106 tests, build ok.
